# Nonlinear Diffusion and Entanglement — scientific reading map

Overview and principal results: README.md
Precise Hilbert-space model, resources and theorem contract: science/model.md
Connected proof route: science/README.md
Stochastic quadratic shear, Brownian Gram determinant, Gaussian mixture: science/conditional_gaussian.md
Sharp EB/PPT threshold, normalized Gaussian packet and Mehler integral: science/exact_threshold.md
Cubic upper/lower bounds with energy-unconstrained diamond norm: science/cubic_distance.md
One fixed finite-energy TMSV qualitative NPT survival: science/fixed_input.md
Gaussian kappa=0 comparison, weak-kappa upper and capacity cautions: science/interpretation.md
Primary-source attribution and internal scientific comparison: references/RELATED_WORK.md
Structured bibliography: references/references.bib
Reproduction commands, checked cases and limits: verification/README.md

Learning route:
- Start with learning/README.md for the physical question, reference-assisted tests and a complete qubit example.
- Follow learning/MILESTONES.md: exactly M01–M30, with 12 background/preliminaries and 18 narrative/innovation targets and their dependencies.
- Use learning/RIVAS_HUELGA_BRIDGE.md to connect the single educational anchor, Rivas–Huelga (2012), to the actual project. Source sections refer to arXiv:1104.5242v2 and are mapped separately to printed-book chapters.
- The source supplies open-systems foundations, not the project's unbounded-generator existence proof or sharp entanglement theorem. These are supplied in science/ with research attribution.

Essential distinctions:
- The full channel is non-Gaussian for kappa>0; only its conditioned paths are Gaussian. The physical receiver has no trajectory record.
- D is position dephasing/momentum diffusion; eta is momentum dephasing/position diffusion.
- The exact threshold includes the eta>0 endpoint; NPT is proved separately below it.
- The kappa=0 Gaussian case has a distinct proof and can have an earlier finite cutoff.
- The cubic rate is an all-input, reference-uniform bound. Exponent constants do not match; do not assert an optimal leading coefficient.
- Finite preparation energy refers to (Q^2+P^2)/2, not an extra trapping term or an energy cutoff in the diamond norm.
- Fixed TMSV NPT does not imply useful memory, positive quantum capacity or constant-quality recovery.
- The model and Mehler propagator belong to Speed–Lyu–Schubert. The Gaussian EB criterion and Gaussian Brownian comparison are inherited.
- Finite numerical checks and navigation tests support their stated scope, not universal proofs or hosted-rendering certification.
